name: gauntlet-loop
description: Agent skill compiling a goal and concrete quality reference into a portable execution prompt with decomposed work, independent criticism and iterative benchmark comparison.

metadata.github_description: Turn any goal into a short prompt that makes your agent set a real quality bar, run builder and critic pairs, compare blind, and loop until it wins.
